description: Defines the implementation class for E2 subscription management, including methods for handling subscriptions, managing E2SM services, and supporting RAN functions within the ocudu namespace.

classes.name: e2_subscription_manager_impl
classes.description: Implementation of the E2 subscription manager handling subscription setup, deletion, and service management.

methods.name: handle_subscription_setup
methods.description: Handles incoming subscription setup requests and returns a response message.

methods.name: handle_subscription_delete
methods.description: Handles subscription delete requests and returns a response message.

methods.name: start_subscription
methods.description: Starts a subscription procedure for a given RIC request ID.

methods.name: stop_subscription
methods.description: Stops the subscription procedure for a given RIC request ID.

methods.name: action_supported
methods.description: Checks if a specific action is supported for a given RAN function and RIC request ID.

methods.name: get_subscription_result
methods.description: Retrieves the outcome of a subscription based on the subscription details.

methods.name: add_e2sm_service
methods.description: Registers a new E2SM service with its OID and interface.

methods.name: get_e2sm_interface
methods.description: Retrieves the E2SM interface associated with a given OID.

methods.name: add_ran_function_oid
methods.description: Associates a RAN function ID with an E2SM service OID.
